description: A snapshot in the public partition (stored when the app setting was on), the public partition now turned off by the app, and a 304 without ETag: the client does not use the public entry, so it sends no If-None-Match and no Rq-Have and does not revalidate; the 304 matches no validator of the request: a normal load (H-81, security review L1; with the setting on: FX-RQ-C27-PUBLIC-SNAPSHOT-304)
